title: Provide service for main switch gear cleaning, visual inspection, breaker servicing, battery replacement and DC control power maintenance located at USCG Base Portsmouth
description:
Provide service for main switch gear cleaning, visual inspection, breaker servicing, battery replacement and DC control power maintenance located at USCG Base Portsmouth. 

  

 The work consists of providing all labor, materials, and equipment, as required, to complete all work as described in the provided Statement of Work (SOW). This procurement is 100% set-aside for Small Businesses using NAICS code of 811310 Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment (except Automotive and Electronic) Repair and Maintenance and a small business size standard of 12.5 million dollars. The Government contemplates award of a Firm-Fixed Price order resulting from this solicitation. See 52.212-2 for evaluation criteria. All quotes must be submitted by 5:00 PM eastern standard time on 12/08/2026 via email to Jamie.C.Bridges@uscg.mil and keven.d.weaver@uscg.mil.  Quotes shall be submitted via the SF-18. Questions about this solicitation must be submitted in writing to the Contracting Officer and Contract Specialist at the email addresses listed above no oral questions will be accepted. 

  

 All potential quoters are strongly encouraged to visit the site to field verify any/all quantities before submitting quotes. A site visit will be held on 12/02/2026 at 1000 eastern standard time located at: 

  

 USCG Base Portsmouth 

 4000 Coast Guard Blvd 

 Portsmouth, VA 23703-2199 

  

 Interested parties must arrange site visits with Nate Chappell at 757-483-8792, Nathan.C.Chappell@uscg.mil and Hayden Heyer 757-375-1183, Gary.H.Heyer@uscg.mil. All visitors must complete a visitor access request form in accordance with Base security policy and present a valid Real ID or Passport as a method of identification. Full name, date of birth, and last 4 of SSN must also be provided. Visitors with a valid Military ID or RAPIDGate pass will not be required to complete the access form. 

  

 The final date and time for questions is 5:00 PM eastern standard time on 12/3/2026. 

  

 There was not an incumbent.
